notes:
- Play with a controller: left stick to move (click to sprint), right stick to look (click to melee),
  RT shoot, LT aim, A jump, B crouch, X reload and interact (hold to buy and rebuild), Y swap weapon,
  RB melee, LB grenade, D-pad for the flashlight and weapons, Back for the scoreboard, Start to pause. Menus
  work with the D-pad / stick and A. Prompts show the controller button ("[X] Buy ...") while you're using one.
- Rebind your keys: CONTROLS lists every action. Click one and press the new key or mouse button. There's
  also "Reset to defaults". Your bindings are saved.
- Controller settings in CONTROLS: look speed and invert look up/down.
